description: This file defines configuration options and setup functions for the PlatformService in Mattermost, including store overrides, configuration loading, logging, clustering, and Redis enabling.

methods.name: StoreOverride
methods.description: Sets a custom store or store constructor for the PlatformService.

methods.name: StoreOverrideWithCache
methods.description: Wraps a store with a local cache layer for testing.

methods.name: StoreOption
methods.description: Adds SQL store options to the store configuration.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Loads configuration from a DSN and applies defaults.

methods.name: SetExportFileStore
methods.description: Sets the export file backend store.

methods.name: ConfigStore
methods.description: Replaces the config store, typically for testing.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger for the PlatformService.
